title: AI editorial review of six flawed longform sources and 18 GPT-OSS rewrites

provenance.note: These are fallible AI editorial judgments on project-generated development fixtures. They are not human gold, a blind preference result, a release gate, or a proof of semantic fidelity.

inputs.role: frozen source fixtures; only six source_flawed items reviewed
frozen GPT-OSS partial-results snapshot; exactly 18 flawed-source longform outputs reviewed

coverage.unreviewed_material: Clean-source longform outputs and all other task kinds in the snapshot; all outputs of other models.

methodology: Inspect each complete source and all baseline/core/full rewrites for that source; for early cases use the full source together with exhaustive word-diff groups, then verify suspected issues in their full paragraphs.
Evaluate whether each seeded defect is functionally repaired, not whether the output matches the fixture clean wording verbatim.
Record exact source and output excerpts, their surrounding paragraph context, severity and confidence for substantive or linguistic regressions.
Separate demonstrable textual changes from interpretation, ambiguous-source risks and minor spelling issues.
Credit useful local edits even when other parts of the same output regress.
Do not use edit distance, output length, unchanged numbers or completion status as a quality score or semantic-fidelity proof.
Do not count numeric formatting, digit-versus-written-number conversion, curly quotes, headings or boldface as factual errors by themselves.
No external claims about the fictional stores, workshops or datasets are validated; judgments concern faithfulness to the supplied source.
The findings list is diagnostic, not an exhaustive assertion that every unlisted sentence is correct.

severity_definitions.major: Changes a substantive reported action, experimental coverage or outcome, or adds an assured outcome unsupported by the source.
severity_definitions.moderate: A local referent, scope, qualifier, direction, action-status or grammatical change materially weakens precision or clarity; paragraph context may still preserve part of the intended point.
severity_definitions.minor: A localized spelling or small grammatical-form regression without a demonstrated change in the reported facts.

confidence_definitions.high: The excerpt and surrounding context directly support the editorial observation.
confidence_definitions.medium: A plausible editorial risk remains, but the source or rewritten phrase admits more than one reading; exclude from strict claims of proven errors.

seed_status_definitions.corrected: The main seeded defect is functionally removed or substantially repaired. This is a local judgment and does not certify the rest of the output.
seed_status_definitions.partially_corrected: The construction is meaningfully shortened or partly repaired, but a substantial residual defect or lost qualification/action detail remains.
seed_status_definitions.cosmetically_rephrased: Words, tense or punctuation change while the same defect remains.
seed_status_definitions.retained: The seeded problematic construction is unchanged or effectively verbatim.
